Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the time this week. Per our discovery, Michael (VP Product) has asked to join the demo and will be traveling late next week. To avoid last-minute juggling, I wanted to propose two options that keep the session a tight 30-minute timebox and still surface the executive-level roadmap questions he usually asks.

Attached is the latest agenda (Demo_Agenda_v2.pdf) — highlights include:
- 5m: context & goals
- 10m: live product walkthrough (latency/cost/SLAs)
- 10m: roadmap + rollout Qs for execs
- 5m: next steps / MAP

Option A: Wednesday 2026-12-22, 11:00–11:30 AM ET
Option B: Thursday 2026-12-23, 08:30–09:00 AM ET (earlier for Michael on his travel day)

If neither works, Laura or Karthik can run the Thursday slot and I can provide a 10-minute pre-brief the day before so Michael gets the top-line context. Short answers welcome — I can send a Calendly link to lock a time.

Thanks,
Connor
